title: Variance against plan with ABS
objective: Work out variance, absolute variance and a flag when the gap is bigger than a tolerance.
instructions: Plan is in column B and actual sales in column C, both in KES thousands (K). In D2:D6 work out the variance: actual minus plan. In E2:E6 work out the absolute variance, which is the size of the gap whether it is above or below plan. In F2:F6 show "Check" when the absolute variance is more than the tolerance in B8, otherwise "OK".
hints: Variance is actual minus plan: =C2-B2. A negative result means the store is below plan.
ABS removes the sign: =ABS(D2) turns -12 into 12.
Use IF with the tolerance cell: =IF(E2>$B$8,"Check","OK"). A gap exactly equal to the tolerance is still OK.
